content: {"decision":"Reject artifact-identity verification and production approval on the proposed evidence.","risks":["Catalog and generation IDs are endpoint claims; they do not prove which artifact served requests.","Offline fixtures cannot detect hosted model substitution, revision drift, or runtime differences.","Production behavior and operational readiness remain unvalidated."],"required_changes":["Mark artifact identity unverified and distinguish API-label conformance from artifact verification.","Require trustworthy artifact-to-deployment-to-request evidence before claiming verified identity.","Gate production on live endpoint validation and operational readiness; if identity evidence is unavailable, retain unverified status and require explicit risk acceptance for any exception."],"evidence_needed":["Trusted provenance or attestation linking an immutable artifact digest and model revision to the deployed service and served requests.","Live endpoint evaluations covering quality, safety, compatibility, load, and failure handling.","Evidence of deployment change controls, drift monitoring, rollback capability, and accountable release approval."]}
